title: Woodcore project
description: <name>.woodcore -- the file that makes a folder a Woodcore project and says where each of its parts is (docs/architecture/layout.md §11). The project's folder is the folder this file sits in; every path in `layout` is relative to it, written with forward slashes, and must stay inside it. Written by hand or by Woodcore, read by calc/project.py alone. A key of `layout` left out takes its default, the layout a new project was created with until the three documents -- `report`, `pdf`, `sources`, `generated` and `archives` each have one; the six keys of a project laid out in three documents (`typst_root`, `images`, `report_cu`, `pdf_cu`, `report_bp`, `pdf_bp`) have none, and are stated all together or not at all. A key Woodcore no longer reads -- `layout.rfem_export` and `gui.rfem_models`, since the RFEM import was retired in 0.117 -- is still valid here, ignored, and said at every export (calc/project.py RETIRED_KEYS).

schema_version.description: -- pinned: a project file written at another version is refused rather than read as this one. 1.1 (Woodcore 0.119, issue #64) is a project laid out by folders, which states `layout.config`; 1.0 is every project laid out before, still read as it was.

format.description: What this file is, so a .woodcore that is something else is refused by name rather than half-read.

name.description: The project's name, as the window and the start page show it.

number.description: The project's number, as the office files it. Printed on the report's title page and in the PDF's metadata, through data/project.json (v0.82). Optional.

client.description: The client (Bauherrschaft). Printed on the report's title page and in the PDF's metadata, through data/project.json (v0.82). Optional.

address.description: Where the structure stands. Printed on the report's title page and in the PDF's metadata, through data/project.json (v0.82). Optional.

company.description: The office the report is written by. Printed on the report's title page and in the PDF's metadata, through data/project.json (v0.82). Optional.

author.description: Who wrote the report. Printed on the report's title page and in the PDF's metadata, through data/project.json (v0.82). Optional.

checker.description: Who checks it. Printed on the report's title page and in the PDF's metadata, through data/project.json (v0.82). Optional.

woodcore_version.description: The Woodcore version this project asks to be opened with, as a prefix -- `0.83` opens it with the newest 0.83.x installed. Read by the launcher a double-click on this file starts (packaging/launcher.py, v0.83). Optional: absent, the newest version installed opens it.

content_templates.description: The content template each document was made from, by document (`cu`, `bp`, `rs`): its reference, `builtin:cu/standard`, `user:rs/holzbau` (issue #88, #90, Woodcore 0.122). Written by Woodcore as a document is created -- at a new project's creation, or later from the «Projet» tab -- and shown there; a document's content template is chosen once and never changed. Additive: absent in a project made before 0.122, whose documents the «Projet» tab then says «inconnu», and a Woodcore older than 0.122 reads the file all the same.

gui.description: What the window keeps with the project rather than with the user (v0.83; named `katalog` until v0.96). Written by Woodcore.

empty_folders.description: Per editor tab (tab_plan, tab_statics, tab_schema, tab_connections, tab_polar), the folders of its list that hold nothing -- a folder being a field of the sources it holds, an empty one has nowhere else to be written (docs/ui/window.md §10quater).

rfem_models.description: Retired in 0.117 with the RFEM import (archive/rfem/): the RFEM table exports a project read. Still valid in a file written before, never written by Woodcore since, ignored, and said at every export (calc/project.py RETIRED_KEYS).

katalog.description: `gui`'s name in a project file written before v0.96, when the window was the Katalog: still read where `gui` is absent, and taken out, its content carried into `gui`, the first time the window writes its empty folders. Never written.

layout.description: Where each part of the project is, relative to the project's folder. A project is laid out as a report alone -- the report's folder is the Typst root, and its config.typ, its pictures and the export lie inside it -- unless `typst_root` is stated: it is then laid out in three documents, the convention d'utilisation, the base de projet and the report (the rapport de statique), each in a folder of its own, compiled from the project's own folder, which holds what the three share (calc/project.py, calc/documents.py). Woodcore writes such a layout in full, every key below stated.

typst_root.description: The folder the documents are compiled from, and read nothing outside of: ".", the project's own folder, and nothing else. Stated, the project is laid out in three documents, and every one of `images`, `report_cu`, `pdf_cu`, `report_bp` and `pdf_bp` is stated with it. Absent, the Typst root is the report's folder, as it has always been.

config.description: The folder holding config.typ, commands.typ, title.typ, references.bib and the form's Template/: `000-Typst-Config`, one folder at the top of the project, read as `/000-Typst-Config/commands.typ`. Stated with `typst_root` only, in a project laid out by folders (schema_version 1.1, issue #64), whose other folders -- 000-Woodcore/, Domains/, the domains' and the drawing tabs' -- are fixed by Woodcore and stated nowhere (calc/project.py DOMAIN_FOLDERS). Absent, those files lie at the top of the Typst root.

report.description: The report's entry file, `Statischer Rapport.typ`. Its folder is the Typst root, unless `typst_root` is stated; in three documents it is the rapport de statique's, `3_Statischer Bericht/Statischer Rapport.typ`, and keeps the name it has always had.

pdf.description: Where the compiled report is written -- the deliverable.

sources.description: The folder holding what is drawn in Woodcore's window: connectors/, connections/, plans/, statics/, details/.

generated.description: The folder the export writes into: data/ (and docs/). Inside the Typst root, since the report reads data/ through the engine -- the report's folder for a report alone, `_woodcore` at the top of the project for three documents, which share it.

archives.description: Where every successful export is archived.

images.description: The pictures the documents' sections set, shared by the three: `Images`, at the top of the project, read as `/Images/...`. Stated with `typst_root`; a report alone keeps its pictures in `Images/` inside its own folder.

rfem_export.description: Retired in 0.117 with the RFEM import (archive/rfem/): where a project kept its RFEM table exports, `RFEM-Export`. Still valid in a file written before, never written by Woodcore since, ignored, and said at every export (calc/project.py RETIRED_KEYS).

report_cu.description: The convention d'utilisation's entry file (Nutzungsvereinbarung, SIA 260's service criteria agreement), in a folder of its own beside its structure.json and its Sections/: `1_Nutzungsvereinbarung/Nutzungsvereinbarung.typ`. Stated with `typst_root`.

pdf_cu.description: Where the convention d'utilisation is compiled to, beside its entry file. Stated with `typst_root`.

report_bp.description: The base de projet's entry file (Projektbasis, SIA 260's basis of design), in a folder of its own beside its structure.json and its Sections/: `2_Projektbasis/Projektbasis.typ`. Stated with `typst_root`.

pdf_bp.description: Where the base de projet is compiled to, beside its entry file. Stated with `typst_root`.
